findings.exact_supporting_passage: as a home health agency in the Medicare program, will be terminated.
findings.access_consequences: CMS provider agreement terminates November 29, 2026. Medicare will not pay for services under care plans established on or after that date; it will pay up to 30 days of covered services for patients with preexisting plans. Physical closure is not established.

findings.title: Intermountain suspends fixed-wing medical requests during FAA nationwide ground stop
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Intermountain suspends fixed-wing medical requests during FAA ground stop
